subject: Request to proceed with hiring runway: Senior Oncall Engineer (Infra) - opening req
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to proceed with hiring runway: Senior Oncall Engineer (Infra) - opening req

Hi team,

We need to move forward with opening a req for a Senior Oncall Engineer to backfill the role on the infra-oncall rotation (replacing Alex, who is moving to product). Quick context: this is a direct replacement headcount tied to an existing approved headcount line (budget code INF-OPS-22). The org impact is minimal but the role is critical to maintain our 24/7 coverage and reduce pageload for SRE.

Ask: please approve proceeding to open the req and the interview slate below so we can start scheduling interviews next week. Details:
- Target level: Senior (IC4)
- Hiring manager: Marissa Cole
- Proposed panel: Marissa (hiring mgr), Laura (tech lead - infra runtime), Stephanie (oncall rotation leads), 1 ad-hoc cross-team engineer
- Timeline: post req by EOD Wed, schedule panel interviews starting Mon (7 business days out)
- Budget: existing approved budget; no uplift request.

If you approve, I will: open the req in Greenhouse, share the panel eval template, and kick the recruiter with an initial candidate slate.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: panel-eval-template.docx (evaluation template we use for panel debriefs)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to proceed with hiring runway: Senior Oncall Engineer (Infra) - opening req

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 9:12 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi team,
> 
> We need to move forward with opening a req for a Senior Oncall Engineer to backfill the role on the infra-oncall rotation...

Thanks Tessa — approved to open the req and proceed with the slate. Confirming I’ll be the hiring manager and will take the first pass on the job post before it goes live. Please include a sentence that emphasizes oncall cadence (8-weeks rotation) and incident leadership expectation in the posting.

Also: flagging that if early pipeline looks strong we should consider a late-stage take-home to evaluate troubleshooting under pressure (open to opinions).

Marissa
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to proceed with hiring runway: Senior Oncall Engineer (Infra) - opening req

Marissa / Tessa —

Thanks for initiating. Quick note: can we open it as "Senior / Staff Oncall Engineer" and indicate we’re targeting Senior but will consider strong Staff candidates? We’re short on Staff-level bench in infra and strong Staff candidates could relieve org risk. If that’s ok with hiring manager + compensation, I’m fine.

Also, I recommend adding Laura-style technical deep-dive question items to the panel (kernel/observability/kv cache behavior) — I’ll send a short list this afternoon.

—Laura
Principal Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to proceed with hiring runway: Senior Oncall Engineer (Infra) - opening req

Thanks — confirming I’ll coordinate panel availability. Proposed blocks (all PT):
- Mon 10:00–12:00 (panel window)
- Tue 14:00–16:00 (backup)

I’ve attached the panel eval template for ease during debriefs. I’ll also create a shared calendar event and a Greenhouse job post draft so we can iterate.

Attachment: panel-eval-template.docx

Steph
Senior SRE Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request to proceed with hiring runway: Senior Oncall Engineer (Infra) - opening req

Hi Tessa / Marissa / team —

Thanks for the heads up. TalentLink has three candidates we think fit the Senior/Staff bar; attached is Amit Shah (resume) as an initial sample — he’s got distributed systems + incident response experience and is ready to interview next week. We’ll push any other strong matches to Greenhouse once the req is posted.

Candidate notes (short):
- Amit Shah — 8 yrs infra/observability; 3 yrs on-call leadership at scale; open to relocation + remote in US; immediate availability after two weeks’ notice.

Attaching: candidate-Resume-Amit-Shah.pdf (resume), brief availability matrix.

We’ll stand by to schedule once you confirm panel windows.

Best,
Amit Shah
Senior Recruiter, TalentLink
